$comment: Scenarios: what people on different apps should be able to do together. A scenario says what is true at the end (done), not how to get there; a run plays it through one path. needs lists what it cannot do without: a single item, or a group of which one is enough (oneOf); extras make it better or more complete but are not needed for a first run; missing names what exists nowhere yet, with its thread. Items are credential profiles, Trust Task types, ceremonies or basics. Listed from the easiest to the hardest.

scenarios.title: Connect across apps
scenarios.asks: Two people on two different apps connect and each holds a credential the other app verifies.
scenarios.done: Two people on different apps run one QR-code ceremony and each holds a credential the other app verifies.
scenarios.origin: Weave one-pager (QR-code contact ceremonies between apps); proposed as a level by rltp; definition format from the DTGWG Trust Ceremonies task force

scenarios.title: Write each other
scenarios.asks: Two connected people on two different apps send each other messages, and a third party holding a message cannot show who wrote it.
scenarios.done: Each person sends one message from their app; the other app shows it in the conversation with that person, the reply arrives the same way, and a third party holding the envelope cannot show who wrote it. A procedure may run it with the sender offline when writing: the message arrives later and is still accepted as of its issue time.

missing.label: A Trust Task type for a person-to-person message

scenarios.origin: Weave one-pager (messaging across apps); proposed as a level by rltp; deniability from rltp

scenarios.title: Prove membership to another app
scenarios.asks: A community states who belongs in a form another app, or a conventional tool, verifies.
scenarios.done: A membership statement issued in one app verifies in another, naming the person and the community.
scenarios.origin: Weave deck, Level 1a; also covers Weave Level 1b (one membership, several apps) once the statement verifies in two or more apps

scenarios.title: Your credentials in several apps
scenarios.asks: One person uses the same contacts and memberships in two apps at once; moving apps is the case where the first one is no longer used.
scenarios.done: Credentials from one app are usable in another: they verify there, the person sees their contacts and memberships in both apps, and both apps keep working.
scenarios.origin: Weave deck, Level 0b (app change with VRCs and VMCs), read as concurrent use

scenarios.title: Same group in two apps
scenarios.asks: Members on different apps read and write the same encrypted group, newcomers read what the group allows, and a removed device reads nothing new.
scenarios.done: A client of one implementation joins a group hosted by another, reads the records already there and writes one the host reads back. A procedure may run it with the writer offline when writing: the record arrives later and the host accepts it as of its issue time.
scenarios.origin: Weave deck, Level 2a; one-pager (being in the same group in two different apps); key agreement at the boundary from rltp (E13)
